subject: M034 settlement infrastructure game loop and operations-surface coherence, usability, visual clarity, and evidence quality
acceptanceCriteria: Planning and constructing water, food, storage, comfort, maintenance, and road infrastructure forms a coherent indirect-control loop.
The operations surface makes stocks, capacities, flows, backlog, needs, alerts, and maintenance understandable without raw JSON.
Player commands remain plans, designations, priorities, policies, region, and time controls rather than direct worker orders.
Water shortage, storage bottleneck, and maintenance failure are visible, diagnosable, and recoverable.
Detailed and abstract regions appear to follow the same game rules.
Region switching and save/load preserve understandable activity and infrastructure state.
Graphical presentation distinguishes plans, delivered materials, completed/failed structures, crops, storage, alerts, and interactions.
The fourteen-day stabilized run demonstrates a sustained loop rather than a scripted demonstration.
Known scope limits are explicit and acceptable before M035 hardening.
No cross-region logistics, individual-character simulation, or M030 integration was introduced.
waiverPolicy: No implicit waiver. A waiver requires explicit request amendment before review and a bounded reason in the completed record.

decisionHistory.notes: Repository user reviewed the M034 operations evidence and approves the blocking review.
